items.title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: This research introduces a novel method for agentic reinforcement learning that allows on-policy distillation to self-retire, improving efficiency and performance.

items.title: How OpenAI Used Its Own LLMs to Design Its Jalapeño Chip
items.summary: OpenAI leveraged its own large language models to assist in the design process of a new hardware chip, showcasing a practical application of AI in engineering.

items.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
items.summary: This article discusses the increasing trend of secrecy among leading AI model development companies, raising concerns about transparency and open research.

items.title: Is the AI industry really ready to slow down?
items.summary: An analysis questions the industry's willingness to decelerate AI development amidst calls for caution and regulation, highlighting the ongoing race for innovation.

items.title: WeVisDoc: From Coverage to Capability for Robust End-to-End Document Parsing
items.summary: New research presents WeVisDoc, a method aimed at enhancing the robustness and capability of end-to-end document parsing systems.

items.title: VABench: Measuring Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Visual Demonstrations, Active Perception, and Metric Control
items.summary: VABench is introduced as a new benchmark designed to evaluate embodied spatial intelligence in AI agents using visual demonstrations and active perception.

items.title: Laya — 33ms Multilingual System 1 Decision Engine
items.summary: Laya is announced as a new multilingual decision engine boasting an impressive 33-millisecond response time, indicating advancements in real-time AI processing.

items.title: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
items.summary: This paper explores CodeMidas, a framework for scaling reinforcement learning environments for agentic coding directly from existing codebases.

items.title: EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents
items.summary: Researchers propose EvoOntology, a self-evolving ontology layer designed to enhance the knowledge representation and adaptability of data agents.

items.title: When2Think: Learning Difficulty-Aware Length Control for Efficient Hybrid Reasoning Models
items.summary: This research introduces a method for hybrid reasoning models to learn difficulty-aware length control, optimizing efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

items.title: UFO: Chain-of-Evaluation for Omni-Condition Alignment in Multi-Modal Image Generation
items.summary: UFO presents a novel chain-of-evaluation approach to achieve omni-condition alignment, significantly improving multi-modal image generation.

items.title: Sample Count Is Not Enough: Candidate-Generation Strategy Shapes the Energy and Performance of LLM Test-Time Scaling
items.summary: A study reveals that the candidate-generation strategy, not just sample count, critically influences the energy consumption and performance of LLM scaling during testing.

items.title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
items.summary: This paper investigates how observation supervision fundamentally alters exploration strategies for agents in reinforcement learning environments.

items.title: Introducing the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint
items.summary: OpenAI has unveiled the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint, outlining strategies and commitments to ensure safer AI interactions for young people.

items.title: Architecting a Resilient DevSecOps Pipeline for Enterprise AI Agents
items.summary: This article provides guidance on building robust and secure DevSecOps pipelines specifically tailored for the deployment and management of enterprise AI agents.
